title: Local State, Event Ledger, Analytical Memory
objective: Persist only bounded metadata required for lifecycle, audit, undo, and Guardian intelligence.

stories.title: Reconstructible current-state store
stories.outcome: Introduce SQLite current state as a cache/index that can be dropped and rebuilt.
stories.risk_reclassification_note: Declared CR2 at planning time; raised to CR3 at commit time because the change touches rust/crates/cancellai-model/src/agent_artifact.rs (adding Deserialize to AgentArtifact and the types it carries) - the domain-model floor project/risk_floors.json sets for that path, since it defines what an artifact, an authority and a plan are and every downstream decision is expressed in its types, even though this change is additive-only (no field, semantics, or existing Serialize output changes).
acceptance_criteria: Deleting the DB never deletes provider artifacts.
Rebuild from filesystem/provider produces equivalent current-state semantics.

stories.title: Append-only operational ledger
stories.outcome: Record significant classification/policy/mutation/lifecycle events without storing artifact content.
acceptance_criteria: Events are immutable after commit except compaction into signed/hashed summary records as specified.

stories.title: Analytical rollups and retention
stories.outcome: Aggregate fine-grained measurements into hourly/daily/long-term statistics with bounded retention.
acceptance_criteria: Raw samples expire according to policy.
Aggregates support growth baseline without retaining sensitive content.

stories.title: Self-budget and local reset
stories.outcome: Enforce cancellAI state/log budgets and provide reset of cancellAI state only.
acceptance_criteria: Budget overrun triggers compaction before growth continues.
Ephemeral inspect performs no persistent writes.
verification: Self-budget stress test and reset boundary tests.

stories.title: Incremental inventory reuse
stories.outcome: Reuse persisted facts safely between scans while invalidating on identity, metadata, provider-knowledge, and completeness changes.
acceptance_criteria: Cached facts are performance hints only and never a source of destructive truth.
Identity, mtime/metadata, provider fingerprint, knowledge version, or completeness uncertainty invalidates the relevant cache scope.
Fresh execution-time observation remains mandatory for mutation preconditions.
verification: Stale-cache, provider-layout-change, clock/mtime edge, and partial-scan adversarial tests.
